api: mpv_create; mpv_initialize; mpv_command(loadfile, local MP4 path); mpv_wait_event(MPV_EVENT_FILE_LOADED); mpv_get_property_string(file-format, metadata/by-key/title, track-list/N/type and codec); mpv_get_property(track-list/count), called from a C++17 translation unit

build_dependencies.role: required by mpv 0.42.0 (>= 7.387.0); renderer only, not called by the null video output
required by mpv; subtitle renderer, not instrumented

coverage: LLVM source coverage in the pinned mpv 0.42.0 demuxer layer (demux/demux_lavf.c) and the FFmpeg 9.0.2 libavformat sources it calls (mov.c box parser), built from source with the same instrumentation and linked into a C++17 byte-input harness that loads a local file through libmpv's loadfile command
parser_family: FFmpeg 9.0.2 MOV/MP4 demuxer (libavformat/mov.c) behind libmpv 0.42.0 demux/demux_lavf.c. FFmpeg is configured with mov as its only demuxer, so no other FFmpeg demuxer can claim the input
shared_parser_family: FFmpeg 9.0.2 MOV/MP4 demuxer (libavformat/mov.c) behind libmpv 0.42.0 demux/demux_lavf.c
shared_parser_family_note: Same pinned mpv, FFmpeg and libplacebo archives, configure options and static libmpv build as projects/mp4/c/mpv; only the call site differs (C++17 with RAII ownership). The FFmpeg rows parse with the same mov.c release directly, without libmpv. This is not an independent parser.
